main_text.l: תגרניתא Contentiosa, Proverb.21.10.19. Vide & תגר.
גרם Ch. In caussa esse, Caussari, Caussam praebere:
Item Conterere, comminuere; Unde Infinit.
Pahel לגרמא Ad comminuendum, Psal.27.2. Item
Roborari, fortificari, ut ברחמותא תגרם In amore ro-
boraberis, Proverb.5.19. Item Syr. Perficere, Con-
summare, idem quod גמר, ad Rom. 9. 28. in Regiis.
Exemplar Viennense habet ꝏ, quod Treme-
lius retinet, ac vertit, Decidit. Aphel Praet. כר אנרים
Cum roboraret, Prov.8.28.
גרמא גרם Ch. & Syr. Os, Ofsis, a robore. Deinde su-
mitur quoque ut Hebraeum עצם pro Ipsemet. Plu-
ral. גרמיא, גרמין, גרמיא: Syr. ܓܪܡܐ.
גרמידא Ch. Cubitus, Brachium, Exod.2.5.in Jon. Ju-
dic.3.16. Hebr. גמר.
גרן * גרון Vide in גרר.
גרס Ch. Frangi, Comminui: Item Legere, Discere,
Studere. Pahel Infin. למגרסא בהון Ut studeant
in eis, Deut.11.19. in Jonath.
גירסא Ch. Lectio, doctrina, studium, explicatio, Can-
tic.1.2. Translat. Germ. Judaeorum,
mit ihrem pilpul/i.e. Gemara cum suis disputatio-
nibus. Gemara est explicatio textus Talmud.
גרע Ch. Minuere, diminuere, imminuere: Syr. spe-
cialiter Diminuere, radere, abradere capillos,
Act.21.24. 1.ad Cor. 11.6. ܓܪܥ Cujus ca-
put rasum est, v.5. Sic in Targum: וגרעת ית שבע
גרילת ורישיה Et abrasit septe cincinos capitis ejus, Jud.16.19.
גרף

page.notes: Hebrew, Greek and Syriac words are reproduced approximately; several Hebrew/Syriac forms with marginal marks and handwritten-looking tittles are uncertain. The final "גרף" stands alone at the foot right as a catchword-like entry; the cursive marks on some lines are doubtful.
